schema.text: Do you drive a car at least once a week to get to places? Count only the trips in which you are the driver.

en.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Do you drive a car at least once a week to get to places? Count only the trips in which you are the driver.

it.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Guidi un'auto almeno una volta alla settimana per i tuoi spostamenti? Considera solo gli spostamenti in cui sei tu alla guida.

fr.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Conduisez-vous une voiture au moins une fois par semaine pour vos déplacements ? Ne comptez que les trajets où vous êtes au volant.

de.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Fahren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche selbst Auto, um irgendwohin zu gelangen? Zählen Sie nur Fahrten, bei denen Sie am Steuer sitzen.

tr.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Bir yerlere gitmek için haftada en az bir kez otomobil kullanıyor musunuz? Yalnızca direksiyonda sizin olduğunuz yolculukları sayın.

fa.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: آیا دست‌کم هفته‌ای یک بار برای رفت‌وآمد خودرو رانندگی می‌کنید؟ فقط سفرهایی را حساب کنید که خودتان راننده هستید.

hu.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Vezet autót legalább hetente egyszer, hogy eljusson valahová? Csak azokat az utakat számolja, amelyeken Ön vezet.

ar.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: هل تقود سيارة مرة واحدة على الأقل في الأسبوع للتنقّل؟ احتسب فقط الرحلات التي تكون فيها أنت السائق.
